Ludwig’s
Little Dream

Little Ludwig loved music. He played the piano every day. One evening, he sat at the piano and opened his music book. He tried a new song, but he made a mistake. He stopped and tried again.

Then he closed his eyes and imagined a big orchestra. In his dream, he stood in front of the musicians. He lifted his hands, and they played his music. The violins sounded like birds. The drums sounded like thunder!

Ludwig smiled and opened his eyes. He picked up a pencil and wrote some notes on a piece of paper. Then he played his little song again. This time, he liked it. His dream started with one small song.
